original_test_intent: Verify all vendor-defined CPU power-consumption sensors are present, readable and semantically correct through the Redfish collection and individual member resources for the installed CPU topology and recorded load context.
original_method: Discover the canonical vendor Sensors collection, enumerate all members without grep truncation, select CPU power sensors by structured identity, GET every member, validate slot/rail/aggregate mapping, reading, units, health, thresholds and timestamp, apply vendor range/aggregation rules, and preserve complete redacted JSON without altering power or logs.
manual_activity: No interactive action is required for a supported ordinary run; the package owner pre-validates the vendor URI, CPU power mapping and range/aggregation rules and reviews only missing, stale, unsupported or inconsistent sensors.
required_inputs: Canonical Redfish Sensors URI and schema
safety_requirements: Do not change power limits or policies
Do not change thresholds or fan control
Use trusted TLS and secret-safe sessions
Do not select coverage by grep text alone
Preserve missing and unknown members explicitly
Fail closed on stale or invalid readings
Do not infer aggregate arithmetic without vendor rules
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, URI and CPU topology
GET and parse every mapped member
Validate units, status, thresholds and timestamps
Apply vendor range and aggregation rules
engineer_actions: Approve sensor mapping and power semantics
Review out-of-range, stale or aggregate mismatch

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The ipmitool grep is read-only but does not implement the source Redfish collection/member procedure and may omit or misidentify sensors; it is auxiliary only if the Project approves cross-interface evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected structured Redfish client to GET the validated collection and every mapped CPU power member, preserving complete JSON and validating topology, units, health, timestamps, range and vendor-defined aggregate relationships.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Redfish CPU-power monitoring intent and 5/5-minute estimate remain; malformed URLs, generic clearing and grep-based substitution are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: COMPLETE TOPOLOGY-AWARE CPU POWER SENSOR VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a per-member table keyed by stable Redfish identity with socket/rail/aggregate role, reading, units, health, threshold, timestamp, load context and rule outcome linked to raw JSON.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces text filtering and response readability with exhaustive structured enumeration and semantic power validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A readable collection or selected grep output cannot prove every expected rail/socket exists, mappings are unique, timestamps are current or aggregate semantics are correct.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power readings depend on workload and sampling window; absence of a controlled load prevents performance conclusions but not schema, mapping, status or vendor-range checks.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define which CPU power sensors are mandatory for each populated topology, which are optional, and how aggregate readings relate to member rails. Do not import DIMM, GPU or unrelated sensor rules from adjacent or duplicate-code rows.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/resource identity, CPU topology and load context
Trusted TLS/auth/client/parser versions with secrets redacted
Complete Sensors collection and every mapped member JSON
Per-member identity, role, reading, units, health, thresholds and timestamp
Range and vendor aggregation validation with missing/stale results

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and source procedure consistently require Redfish CPU power monitoring. DeepSeek's IPMI substitution conflicts with the reference review method but has no source authority and therefore does not create a Master source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The vendor URI/schema, topology and power rules are normal package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if sensors cannot be uniquely mapped or interpreted after the normal package request.

review_improvement: Restores the specified Redfish path and makes CPU power coverage exhaustive, topology-aware and semantically testable rather than a grep-based sample.
independent_technical_reasoning: Sensor correctness is a set-completeness and semantics problem. Each expected topology element needs exactly one mapped resource, and each resource needs valid dimensional units, freshness and health. Aggregate sensors may use internal domains or averaging windows, so only vendor-defined relationships—not assumed sums—can serve as an oracle.
